text: @OriginalFallofMindHi there! 😊 Thank you for your message! The tension between technology and artistry is not new and I totally appreciate your perspective & understand its origin! Walter Benjamin wrote about how mechanical reproduction transformed the nature of art long before computers existed. Every major technological shift—from photography to digital animation—raised fears that human creativity would be diminished. Yet the enduring value of art has never been the tool itself, but the vision, taste, emotion, and intent behind its use. The challenge with AI is not whether it creates, but how society chooses to integrate it while preserving opportunities for human artists. 🌊🤍✨
